# Read Call Chain

![Read Call Chain function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/error/13-read-call-chain.svg)

[Error functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Returns the call chain as a 1D string array and indicates whether an alternate location was stored.
